assessment: Alpha1184: Added self-contained, bounded and thread-safe real simulator vertical movement proof for jump/flying ascent/descent. Current C++ viewer movement controller already sent up/down/fly AgentUpdate bits, but no sign-sensitive actual SERVER altitude readback; original WASD horizontal monitor explicitly ignored z. New vertical_movement_feedback.hpp accepts only queued/current directions and UDP SOCKET-SUCCESS send flags (not queued packet or local animation) and after that only authenticated/current server-origin SELF positions from ImprovedTerseObjectUpdate, ObjectUpdate and ObjectUpdateCompressed accepted by WorldModel and current LocalID/region. Real vertical +/- signed >=0.25 m needed, horizontal-only and gravity wrong sign cannot confirm. Bounded stale/pre-send/out-of-order and >=32m teleport invalidation, 4sec+3 actual self position samples stall, right-way and opposite server samples counted separately, FLY modifier source tracked on same command. A different up/down command or fly mode change clears previous confirmation, idle and all nine original logout/login/epoch/local-ID/invalid self position/reset events clear vertical state as they do horizontal proof. F3 appends 'Steigen/Sprung', 'Sinken' actual simulator proof/wait/stall diagnostic to existing horizontal WASD/yaw status only while queued or actual UDP sent. One real native CTest nexverse-vertical-movement-feedback-tests and ten Python runtime source contracts. NO real authenticated GRID altitude readback was performed this turn, so complete WASD/Yaw/Jump/Flight E2E still open. No new server protocol requirements from OpenGenesisLINK upstream main d93b491318e10ad236ad906c71d995067eb470c4. Avatar/COF/3xRGB final skin and full Firestorm UI parity and Windows/macOS releases still open. Real live authenticated Grid Skin/Outfit and server-confirmed WASD/Yaw E2E still open. Release gate BLOCKED; no deploy.
